entities.summary: Isabella Mary Beeton, known as Mrs Beeton, was an English journalist, editor and writer. Her name is particularly associated with her first book, the 1861 work Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management. She was born in London and, after schooling in Islington, north London, and Heidelberg, Germany, she married Samuel Orchart Beeton, an ambitious publisher and magazine editor. Isabella Beeton was a performers & entertainers from London (1836-03-12, London–1865-02-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
